notes: Large-source-unit check: מִ+לְּ+בַד is retained as one unit. The three morphemes are contiguous, the single English besides carries the sense of each, and no morpheme owns a part of the word (rule 30); head on the lexeme-bearing בד (rule 23).
The two the's of the burnt offering of the new moon are counted by rule 29's arthrous case: the article takes the one before its own word and the construct takes the supplied one.
In the continual burnt offering the rectum is rendered attributively and anarthrously, so the present article takes the fronted the.
